lanes.description: Existing manually labeled sentence-veto v10 suite used as the first no-spend representative proxy.
lanes.interpretation: Useful for measuring product-facing recall on broader active/shadow/no-winner examples; still not a final browsing distribution.

next_steps: Inspect failure rows and suite breakdowns before changing thresholds.
Prefer data/evidence fixes when negative allows cluster by missing phrase or shadow evidence.
Prefer policy fixes only when score traces already expose the correct no-replace signal.

policy.description: Product-oriented semantic-veto quality policy. Good replacements should usually be shown, and bad replacements should be hidden often enough to improve browser UX.

decision_rationale: The measured lanes do not meet the initial product target.
Use failure rows to decide whether the next work is evidence, scoring, or policy.
